description: This file initializes a React application by mounting the App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then renders the App inside a React.StrictMode wrapper for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React DOM node for rendering.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM at the created root.
